title: Don’t Command, Cultivate: an Exploratory Study of System-2 Alignment
reasoning: The paper investigates 'System-2 Alignment' for safety, which involves benchmarking and evaluating how models reason through ethical implications and safety policies. It specifically includes categories like 'Hate' (defined by protected characteristics such as religion) and 'Ethical Considerations' as part of its reasoning and classification framework for model outputs.
